children: Spire entered into a Delayed Draw Term Loan Agreement providing $400 million in senior unsecured commitments to support general corporate purposes. The facility, led by Mizuho Bank with a syndicate of lenders, allows up to four borrowings through the earlier of full utilization, the fourth draw, or Dec. 31, 2026. Borrowings will bear interest at a base rate or Adjusted Term SOFR plus 0.80%, and the loan matures 364 days after the effective date. The agreement includes customary covenants, including a maximum 70% consolidated capitalization ratio.
: Senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility
: Mizuho Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
